description:
Homes like one listing in its own market, picked by Cubi's similarity model.

    Use when the user likes a home and wants more like it nearby ("more like
    #2", "anything similar?"). Returns up to `limit` listings in the same city
    with the same type family and a similar size, ranked by Cubi's similarity
    model: a nearest-neighbour search over each listing's concept embedding (a
    50-dimension PCA of its catalogued features) followed by a hybrid ranker
    over stated features, size, location and asking price; `method` says
    which embedding served the request. Each match carries a `card` (price,
    size, place, link) and a `why` sentence written by the ranker from what
    both listings state ("same city · within 7% on price") — relay that
    reason, don't invent one. Asking prices, not valuations: never call a
    match cheaper "better value".

    For a home like this one in ANOTHER city, call `find_similar_elsewhere`.

    Args:
        listing_id: Source-prefixed id of a listing already shown (e.g.
            `remax:12345`). Do not invent one.
        lang: ISO 639-1 code (en/pt/es/fr/de/nl/ru) for the `why` sentences.
        limit: How many matches to return (1-5, default 3).

    Returns:
        JSON: seed_id, count, method {embedding, ranker, scope}, matches[{card,
        why, similarity}]; or a not-found message.
name: find_similar_homes
title: Find similar homes nearby
